info.title: Cookieless Analytics agent API
info.description: Aggregated analytics for agents and scripts. Send the key in the X-Api-Key header; Authorization: Bearer cannot be used because the host rejects unknown bearer tokens. Scopes: read:analytics, read:search, sync:search, write:annotations, write:dashboards, write:events, data:export, data:import.

post.summary: Run one report. query.compare segment with query.compareSegment compares two segments on the same range (not on search reports, the SEO views or impact). Search reports, including the SEO views, need read:search instead; pages with withSearch and impact over a search report need both. Revenue reports (revenue, revenue_series, revenue_breakdown, revenue_orders) answer in params.currency, default the site's defaultCurrency, list every currency with orders in data.currencies and name the currency in meta.currency; money of two currencies is never added. Long ranges and ranges before the detailed window are answered from daily summaries (notices summary, filter_unavailable:<dim>:<reason>, detail_from:<day>; errors raw_only and narrow_range; the catalog's summaries entry has the rule).

post.summary: Record 1 to 20 events, typically orders from a payment webhook; invalid items are listed in data.rejected by index; a repeated order id replaces the stored amount and currency, a void item nulls them, both count in data.duplicates.

name.description: Event name; a leading underscore is reserved.

val.description: Order value, rounded to the currency's minor unit. Not with refund.

cur.description: ISO 4217 code; absent means the site's default currency.

oid.description: Order id: one order is stored once, by any path. Reposting it here replaces the amount and currency and counts in data.duplicates. Never stored.

void.description: With name and oid only, no val: sets the stored order's value and currency to null, the event stays. An order id not stored is rejected with unknown_order. Works inside the raw window only.

refund.description: With name, oid and rid: refund this amount of the stored order (same name and oid), booked on the refund's own day (ts) with the order's attribution, page and currency. Partial refunds add up; above the order's amount is refund_exceeds_order, an order id not stored is unknown_order, cur other than the order's is currency_mismatch. sid, u and p are not read.

rid.description: Refund id, required with refund: a refund is stored once per order and refund id, so a retry counts in data.duplicates. Never stored.

sid.description: The page's session id (window.<namespace>.sid) to attribute the event; absent stores it unattributed.

ts.description: Epoch seconds, from 30 days ago (and after the first day of the raw window) to 60 s ahead; absent means now.

u.description: Path; absent means the session's last page.

post.summary: One chunk of a table's stored rows as NDJSON (application/x-ndjson, one row per line, under 1.2 MB), read by primary key. Headers: x-next-cursor (URI encoded JSON array for the next call; absent when the table is done), x-layout (table layout), x-engine (sqlite or postgres), x-total (row count, on the first call of a table only). Used by the ca-data CLI for backups and moves.

site.description: Only this site's rows; absent means every site of the database (a key with a site restriction always gets its one site).

table.description: One of the nine analytics tables.

cursor.description: The next-cursor header of the previous call; absent or null starts at the beginning.

limit.description: Rows at most; default 50 on the small capacity profile, 500 otherwise. An answer also stops before 1.2 MB: ask for fewer rows after an answer that came back short with a next cursor.

200.description: Rows, one JSON object per line.

post.summary: Insert rows written by data/dump. Idempotent: a row whose key exists is kept as it is, so a repeated chunk inserts 0 rows; counters of ca_srv and ca_drops are not added. A layout other than the site's answers 400 layout_mismatch; a row whose site, columns or values the table cannot store answers 400 invalid_row; 409 delete_running or move_running while a delete of the Data page or a data move into that database runs. On the small capacity profile with D1 the rows count against the day's copy rows (shared with the data move): 429 daily_limit with Retry-After to 00:00 UTC. Answers data.inserted; an empty rows array writes nothing and answers data.layout and the table's row count in data.total.

site.description: When set, every row must be of this site.

layout.description: The table layout of the export; must equal the site's (x-layout of data/dump).

table.description: One of the nine analytics tables.

rows.description: Rows as data/dump wrote them, one object per row.
